observations.doc_says: Eph 2:12-18: far off = no hope and without God; brought near; hostility killed; peace to far and near. The nearness is made, not reached. I read two distances closed together.
observations.obs_text: Those who were far off are described by what they lack, hope and God; their nearness is brought about for them (hostility put to death, peace preached to far and near) and is not something they reach. Read: two distances, to God and to one another, are closed by the same act.

observations.doc_says: Joh 21:7-8: one sees and says it, Peter leaps, the others come not far from the land. I read one recognition met three ways, none rebuked.
observations.obs_text: One recognition, spoken by one disciple, is met in different ways: Peter hears it and throws himself into the sea, the others come in the boat with the net. Read: none of the responses is corrected.

observations.doc_says: Luk 15:19-22: still a long way off, the father saw, felt compassion, ran; the rehearsed hired servants is never said. I read the son's self-rating set aside, not argued with.
observations.obs_text: The son rehearses a request to be treated as a hired servant because he is no longer worthy, but the father, seeing him still far off, is moved with compassion and runs to him; the servant request is never spoken. Read: the son's rating of himself is set aside, not argued with.
